task: Rewrite the supplied product change as a short user-facing changelog entry. Add a plain heading and one sentence. State the practical user benefit. Use only the supplied facts; do not promise broader coverage or outcomes.

source.change: When a person changes the time zone in a saved schedule, the editor now retains that person's selected days. Before this change, changing the time zone reset the day selection to all days.

scoreDimensions.format: 0 = no heading or more than one sentence; 1 = heading and one sentence but not a usable changelog entry; 2 = plain heading plus one concise sentence.
scoreDimensions.behavior: 0 = incorrect or missing; 1 = partly accurate; 2 = accurately states retained selected days and the time-zone trigger.
scoreDimensions.factuality: 0 = material unsupported claim; 1 = minor unsupported embellishment; 2 = every material claim is supported by the source.
scoreDimensions.userValue: 0 = unclear or not user-facing; 1 = understandable but benefit is indirect; 2 = concise, plain wording that states the practical benefit.
